main_text.head: PRAEFATIO.
main_text.p: fcio an alia tribui Iurifconfulto maior possit. nam ceteri, quid de quaque re iuris sit, & (vt Aristoteles loquitur) τὸ ὅτι vsu tàtùm & tractatione cognoscunt: hic etiam qua de caussa quidꝙ iuris sit : hoc est (vt idem loquitur) τὸ διότι animaduertit: siquidem Ars est, (vt idem luculenter definit) rei cuiusque per suas caussas cognitio, quæ aliter se habere nō possunt. Etenim (vt ex doctissimi viri Matthæi Delii præceptis atque sermonibus eruditissimis iampridem cognouisti) à Dialecticis certa quadã veri falsiq; in omnibus disputationibus cognoscendi ratio animaduersa est. Idem rem vniuersam in partes distribuunt,

page.notes: Lines are set in a narrow column with italic type for the Latin text. The Greek words τὸ ὅτι and τὸ διότι are in Greek letters as printed. Text ends mid-sentence at the bottom of the page: "buunt," is printed with the comma; the final word is written as printed. The first line "fcio" may be a fragment of "scio" with the long s partly cut off; read as printed. The word "si quidem" appears as "siquidem" in print. Show-through and page edges not transcribed.
